summary.headline: Astrological Catalogue Entries 128–143
summary.text: Astrological catalogue entries 128–143 and an unnumbered item on servitude, Mars’s rising and setting, monstrous births, death timing, dangers in nativities, benefits, bodily features, parental death, prostitution, illness, longevity, and the Indian noupouchar division of zodiacal degrees. The list also treats even and odd values, malefics, lunar configurations, and the powers and natures of the Moon, Sun, Saturn, and Jupiter, with a reference to Codex Bononiensis 18.
